name: FIMACOR
recent: FIMACOR 于 2026 年 9 月 1 日召开第 51 届常年股东大会，所有决议均获通过。公司随后在 9 月至 11 月期间按月公布种植/木材生产数据，并于 11 月 18 日发布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的合并业绩。近期没有新闻报导。
notable: 第 51 届常年股东大会于 2026 年 9 月 1 日举行，所有决议均以投票方式通过。
公司发布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的合并业绩。

ann.title: Quarterly rpt on consolidated results for the financial period ended 30/09/2026

recent_en: FIMACOR held its 51st AGM on 1 September 2026, with all resolutions passed. The company subsequently released monthly production figures for plantation/timber from September to November, and announced its consolidated quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 18 November. There was no recent news coverage.
notable_en: The 51st AGM was held on 1 September 2026, and all resolutions were passed by poll.
The company released its consolidated quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
